name: Wiki tidiness
ownerWords:
messy as fuck. ... every day checks their area of responsiblity and proactively (as an actual person would) watch and maintain dashboards, identify issues, act on issues, clean up ... llm-wiki, agent file update & stale 쳐내고

slop slop slop slop blocks of text
goal: Every live page under apps/ and domains/ that a reader still sees is current and in the page shape of skills/wiki/references/writing.md. No page whose status is superseded, deprecated, archived or retired, and no one-off record (a title that names a day, or kind incident or postmortem), stays outside archive/, because the sidebar shows every page there except a moved page's redirect stub. No live page reads as a wall of text by the prose lint: a paragraph over 3 sentences or 80 words, 100 words or more of prose before its first diagram or table, or any other lint error such as a path:line in prose (c248). The line sits above the lint's own 2 sentences or 50 words, because on 11-26 pages with 3-sentence paragraphs of 55 to 59 words and leads of 36 to 66 words read fine, while the walls ran 4-sentence paragraphs and 150 or more words before a visual. The target is 0 because the owner asked to clear out stale things every day and called a curated page's paragraphs 'blocks of text'. projects/ is out of scope. Links, dates, missing meta, unlisted pages and the 800-word core-length warning stay with the Wiki dream duty, stale code facts with Wiki and skill facts, and dated-path pages no curated page links with Agent factory's d7.

Inputs the precheck could not read

onMiss: Fix every flagged page this run, one subagent per page, until pages_needing_fix is 0; each item names the page, its kind and its reasons. Every change goes through the wiki page API (the sieun-pi wiki module, or POST /wiki/api/agent/move), never a file write. For a retired_page item: find each current page that links it with /wiki/api/agent/page backlinks, and repoint each link to the page's superseded_by survivor or drop the row, because the page API answers 409 when a current page still links a page you archive. Then set status archived with an archived_reason that says what replaced it, and move the page to archive/<same path> with POST /wiki/api/agent/move {path, to}, which leaves a redirect stub the sidebar hides. For an off_shape item: rewrite the page into the shape of domains/devops/clickhouse-layout.html under skills/wiki/references/writing.md, with its main mermaid diagram or table right after the title and one lead paragraph, one or two short sentences and at most 50 words per paragraph, code spots named in plain words, and a refs table at the end for paths, commits and message ids. Keep every fact the page states, check the draft with node apps/wiki/scripts/prose-lint.mjs --path <page> <draft> from ~/src/sieun-pi until it shows no error, since the page API refuses a write that adds one, and bump updated. Then rerun the precheck (scripts/duties/wiki-tidiness.ts in sieun-pi legacy/prime/user-history) and go again. A false count gets a fix in wiki-tidiness.ts with a case in test/duty-wiki-tidiness.test.ts. Report the counts before and after with the pages; a quiet day sends nothing.
